answers.how: A quadratic fit to tracked window positions gives the train's motion; extrapolating to 1 s and scaling 158 px to 1.8 m gives this speed.
Near 0.5 s, the train moves about 166 px per frame at 24 fps. Using 1.8 m per 158 px gives this speed.
Tracked windows give approximately 1.4 px/frame² acceleration. Converting with 24 fps and 1.8 m per 158 px gives this value.
The door's vertical length is approximately 180 px, compared with the 158 px window width representing 1.8 m.
The central pillar is approximately 296 px tall. Scaling by the 158 px window width representing 1.8 m gives this height.
